name: Warsong Outrider
summary: On the road east from Ashenvale, the Warsong Outrider watches the Horde's frontier. She scouts for the Warsong clan, watches travelers, and sends intelligence to its forward encampments. She keeps watch unless someone provokes her.

sections.title: Eyes on the Eastern Frontier
sections.body: The Warsong Outrider watches the road between Ashenvale and Azshara's shattered ruins. Far from Splintertree Post and the lumber camps, she tracks troop movements along the route. Her bow and toxic stingers are ready, but she fires only at Alliance trespassers who attack her.

faq.q: Where can the Warsong Outrider be found?
faq.answer: She watches the main road in eastern Ashenvale, which leads into Azshara.

faq.q: Will the Warsong Outrider attack Alliance players on sight?
faq.answer: No. She does not attack passing Alliance travelers unless they strike her first.

faq.q: What is her role in the Warsong clan's operations?
faq.answer: She scouts the Ashenvale and Azshara border, watches for threats, and sends field reports through scouts to the Warsong clan's leaders.

faq.q: Does defeating the Warsong Outrider yield any treasure?
faq.answer: No. Defeating her yields no loot or specialized equipment. It only clears the road or disrupts Horde reconnaissance.

angles.text: Outriders like her keep supply and scouting routes open between Ashenvale's contested logging operations and Azshara's wild coasts.
Though she serves the Horde, this scout holds her fire against Alliance travelers unless provoked, letting wary travelers pass unharmed.
